title: 美联储今年或按兵不动：短中期债券是甜点区，长期利率波动会如何影响市场？
speaker: John Woods

segments.en: So what's your advice for people looking at a Treasury curve? Where do you want to be there? And how does this affect the Fed? Do you fear the hawkishness around the Fed?
segments.zh: 那么您对关注国债收益率曲线的人有何建议？应该处于哪个位置？这对美联储有何影响？您是否担心美联储的鹰派立场？

segments.en: Well, we're at Lombard earlier, possibly contrarian, in that we do not see the Fed moving this year. Admittedly, the market is pricing in a hike.
segments.zh: 我们在隆巴德的观点可能逆势，我们认为美联储今年不会行动。诚然，市场正在定价加息。

segments.en: But we think that as inflation ticks lower, both headline and core as the CPI ticks lower, we think that those rate heights will be reprised.
segments.zh: 但我们认为，随着通胀回落，无论是整体还是核心CPI，加息预期将被重新评估。

segments.en: So I don't think this is necessarily a short-end story. Consequently, my sense is that you are in a short to medium duration positioning for the optimum return.
segments.zh: 因此，我认为这不一定是一个关于短端的故事。因此，我的感觉是，为了获得最优回报，应该配置短中期久期。

segments.en: I think that the long end is going to be a little bit volatile because the market will be reacting to stories as we saw last night. But for us, it's a short to mid-duration story, sort of maybe four, five years, that's our sweet spot.
segments.zh: 我认为长端会有些波动，因为市场会对消息做出反应，就像昨晚那样。但对我们来说，这是短中期久期的故事，大约四五年，这是我们的甜点区。

segments.en: What we learn from the sell-off on long rates is that it seems like it's awoken the cross-asset correlations again, where it's starting to wobble stocks a bit.
segments.zh: 从长端利率抛售中我们学到的是，它似乎再次唤醒了跨资产相关性，开始让股市有些波动。

segments.en: You're starting to get gold, maybe reaffirmal about that correlation with the dollar. I mean, how do you look at the correlations now in this market?
segments.zh: 黄金开始出现，可能再次确认与美元的相关性。您如何看待当前市场中的相关性？
